title: derm secrets
description: ~/.derm/secrets.json (wave 6 lane 6C; contracts/policy.md section 8; the wave 6 base, 12 Nov 2026): the secrets derm-egress injects, by id, with the hosts each may go to and where its value is read at chat start. Never a value. Written only by `derm secret` from a terminal; owner-only, as the policy file.

placement.description: Where else the value is swapped in toward the secret's own hosts, beside the request's headers: one named field each, `body:<path>` (a dotted JSON path, `[n]` for an array index, or one form field) or `query:<param>`. The value is written for its place: percent-encoded in a query or a form, JSON-escaped in JSON; a body is read only as `application/json` (or `+json`) or `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`; a copy of the placeholder anywhere else leaves every copy as the fake (review W6C-S8, Tony's call of 13 Nov; note BD). Absent: headers only (decision 2, Tony's call of 12 Nov). Written by `derm secret add --in body:<path>|query:<param>`.
